description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing Self Beneficiaries TPT (Third Party Transfer) in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving templates, adding, updating, deleting, and listing beneficiaries, with annotations for Swagger documentation and JAX-RS RESTful services.

classes.name: SelfBeneficiariesTPTApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing Self Beneficiaries TPT, including endpoints for template retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and listing.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Returns account type options for beneficiary creation, including savings and loan account types.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new Self Beneficiary TPT using provided JSON data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing beneficiary identified by beneficiaryId with provided JSON data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a beneficiary identified by beneficiaryId.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all beneficiaries linked to the current user.
